blocks.content: Write a program to find Nemo.

items: Get three string inputs from the user and store them in the input1, input2, and input3 variables.
Create a string vector called fish.
Add input1, input2, and input3 to the vector.
Search element Nemo in the vector using the find() algorithm.
Store returned value of the algorithm in the itr iterator.
Check if Nemo is present in the vector

blocks.content: Hint: To check if an element is present in the vector, check if the value of itr is not equal to the end() iterator.
